title: I don’t recommend the app. Too frequent bugs
content:
I recently had 2 major bugs with the app. 1st one both of my trips disappeared from the app. Fortunately they were synchronized properly online and I was able to uninstall the app and reload everything without issues. However, 2nd one, is the one that will make me quit Polarsteps and find an other option to record and share my trips. I did a 7 day cruise in AK with no service. Every evening I was using Polarsteps as a diary to record my adventures. I was also making sure my phone was outside to get the GPS signal and therefore an accurate GPS tracking through Polarsteps. Honestly, it took me a good amount of time but I was proud and happy with my recordings and could not wait to get WiFi and upload it for my family and friends. Unfortunately, the upload failed (several times), the app ended up crashing. When I reopened the app most of my trip had disappeared. No more GPS track or stories I had recorded. I am so sad and devastated. I learnt that I should not rely on this type of services.

Edit: I have reached out to the support team and have submitted all needed info for them to look at my situation. I have not heard back yet.

Beyond just traveling, which I unfortunately haven't been able to do much of yet, it is just so great for organizing my life.

I have three big suggestions for improving the app, however. The first is that I really wish there was a gallery view option for the photos in each step. I really dislike that i have to scroll through all of the photos to see a specific photo or video i uploaded, and i think adding a option to see a gallery view of the photos would be great for instant access to all the memories. Additionally, I think it would be amazing if you could "collaborate" with others on the app for trips. I'm planning a trip with my friend to mexico soon, and it would be nice if there was an option to tag others or contribute to a shared trip. Finally, while i love the flags concept, I do think it would be a cherry on top to have a "digital passport" kinda thing, where you can flip through a (fake) passport of all your countries with their stamps and have them all in one place given that physical passports do expire eventually. Besides these, I love this app so far and i can't wait to keep using it!

title: Great app, room for improvement
content:
I’d like to start off by saying that I absolutely love the step tracking features in this app. It’s like the perfect digital journal for my trips. There are just a few features that irk me when trying to use the newer features. I don’t understand why, if you can load predicted routes using roam to rio, we can’t just use the predicted route as an actual one in step tracking. I hate having to use the steps suggested when tracking is on, but the straight lines look sooo bad in the finished trip map. Why can’t I just say, “yes I took the exact route suggested by roam to rio, use that for the map”? The tracked steps are always random and sometimes skip major sections so it doesn’t follow our route.

 And I want to buy one of the travel books so badly because I spent so much time documenting my trip in this app that there’s no way I’m creating a book in another one, but the features to edit the layout are extremely limited. Only getting to fit 4 photos on a page with a 400 page limit is so hard! If I have a long trip or I want a more photos I’m unable to fit everything I want to show. I took a 2 month trip and was so excited to print the book only to realize that I’d have to pick like 4 photos for each step and they don’t fit onto the page very efficiently. I would gladly drop the $200 for a large travel book if I could actually control the page layouts.

Finally, is there any plan to incorporate the 3D globe that androids have for the iPhone app. I love being able to look at all the steps on the globe on my friends phones but it’s just a flat, non-interactive map on the iPhone. Again, I love the app and I use it all the time, I just wish it had a few more features to make documentation easier.

author: GrannyT15

title: Freedom Van
content:
Great app, easy to use. We purchased the book, it looks very good and arrived quickly.
The app has minimal editing options, however the simpler approach keeps the time spent more focused on the adventures instead of  time fussing with the picky details of the formatting, etc.
author: mailman603

title: Doesn’t work properly - confusing UX/UI
content:
I was looking for an app that could track my travels and saw a travel buddy with this so decided to try it.

As a UX Researcher/Designer I have no shortage of problems with this app but more importantly, it fails at its basic task.

I put in 2 countries and it shows I’ve visted 0, yet shows two small dots on the countries it says I haven’t visited? Interesting.

Sometimes it does show 1 country but has never showed 2. I guess I have to find another app.
author: Future Tomorrow

title: Traveling son
content: I am able to follow my sons journey through Mexico, knowing he is safe and have an experience of a lifetime I can live vicariously through his journals and photos
author: agoodmom4

title: Slight improvement needed
content: I really like this app so far. The only thing missing, which is super important, is to assign an airport. Waiting for a connecting flight or transportation doesn’t exactly count as visiting the country. The option to only assign the Airport, would be a game changer.
author: life_goes_on_

title: Have tried to like this app
content:

It also won’t let you go on until you have to entered info into previous blank.  Super frustrating.
author: ZingL6

title: Best Travel App Ever!
content: This is the best travel app ever first it tracks everywhere you go second it really cool to see and third you can show your friends every you been YOU HAVE To DOWNLOAD THIS APP!! You will love it!!
author: Prestoncoinhunter

title: Great app, but takes time for books to arrive
content: This app is fantastic. Easy to use and translates into wonderful designs. I ordered two books and one showed up within two weeks, the other took two months. It took a lot of back and forth with support to finally get the book. I’m based in the USA so that might be the issue (maybe best to limit use of this to Europe).
author: Bob-a-job-a-jobbie

title: Keeping track of kids!
content: Our kids grow up and have wonderful adventures. And Mama sits home and worries. This app has been a lifesaver for my peace of mind. I follow her exciting trips and relish her joy of travel!
author: R999111

title: Return customer
content: I used this app for our first River boat cruise. It is easy to use and we enjoy looking at our book and seeing our trip and where we had gone. You forget after a few years. Very thankful for this app that provides a wonderful service to preserve  memorable events in our lives.
author: Decorinaday

title: Love this app
content: My husband and I are on a big six month trip and we wanted our family to be able to track our trip and see pictures of our adventure.  We are two months in and are very happy with the app.  We had a little issue early on and I emailed customer service and they went above and beyond to help me through it.  They were super quick to respond and helped me figure out what was goin on.  We post an update every day and have hundreds of pictures and it’s all been super easy to use and we love the map that shows where we’ve been and where we are going

content:

author: Aldo Pavon

title: Love Polar Steps
content: So great to be able to see my granddaughter’s adventures so many miles away.
author: Deanna Virginia

title: Amazing app
content: Such an easy way to track travel, I mostly love it. I was able to share our most recent road trip without any effort! I especially appreciate the import prior travel feature, it’s foolproof! My only complaints are (1) that it is a bit sluggish; I had to uninstall and reinstall several times to get it to be more responsive, and (2) I wish the Facebook share would display all photos in a sideshow instead of just one, so not a major issue.
author: vashka0310

title: Great Fun
content: We had a great time sharing our photos with our friends and family!

author: Ms Shoes

title: Love this app
content: PolarSteps makes it so easy to share my pictures with family and friends while I am traveling. I absolutely love that, after my adventure is done, I can use the app to create the most gorgeous book to save and enjoy for years to come.
author: 301279642783Kat

title: PolarSteps
content: Love this app. We’ve been on the road for 9 months and have used this as our electronic journal.  Bonus, friends and family can follow along.  It will be in my top 5 of “things” I’d keep if I could only choose 5!  Now, PolarSteps needs to figure out to offer a feature where I can buy a printout of my beautiful trip map that was created in the app!!!  😉
author: Lora-O

title: Amazing Tracker
content:
I love this app. Polarsteps easily tracks stops on roadtrips and flights - the trip tracker is awesome. Also love the profile page, especially the overall map view that has the red dots to show all trip stops - the only thing I’d want to see improved would be being able to see that map up close. Like if you could tap on the overall trip map behind the profile photo so you could see top level how many spots someone has been. That map is one of the coolest features but it’s kinda hidden behind the profile photo and other UI elements on the top half of that page. Even if you just repeat that map element at the bottom of the profile, so keep it up top behind the profile photo (because it’s great to see as the first thing), but then as a user scrolls down the profile through all the stats, you get to that map again - but here you can zoom in and actually see all the Stop Dots without any UI blocking it - that would be awesome!
Really love your app. Can tell it’s designed and built by avid travelers!
author: princetongirl12

title: Amazing App!
content: I used Polar steps to document a vacation in England and then Italy.  Works like a charm.  I have recommended it to friends dozens of times.  Love it!
author: Gvdigg

title: I love this app but it’s been crashing lately
content: I absolutely love this app but it’s been crashing lately also I wish there were more recommended places outside of Europe
author: Arianna583

title: So easy with great features
content: This app is terrific. It captures your location and creates an easy to view map. Posting pictures and creating memos is so simple. Easy to share and lots of options to keep private. The stats are really fun to track too! Highly recommend. Look forward to creating a few books too. Takes a little bit of time to get use to interface but simple once you get it down.
author: lrgsail

title: Not a new user.
content: I have used this app before and really liked it. Not sure what has changed but I am on a trip at the moment and I am not sure what is going on with this app. It is literally all over the place! content: I have no social media but I’m taking life on the road. Loved ones ask me “how can we keep track of you and see pics?” Welll now they finally can!!! Thank you a million times !
author: Yaisah

title: Great app HORRIBLE SHIPPING PURCHASES
content:
I’ve use the app for multiple trips. I bought three photo books now from them; super slooowwww delivery... despite the promises of two weeks delivery the first book took a month to arrive.

I would pay the cost of a book to get a pdf. Why create this amazing digital experience then force me to paper??

author: Literarylass

title: Travel & tell
content:
Love this app. Easy way to share your travels and most importantly all your pictures with your interested friends. When you get home you can get a book of the whole trip!  I find that editing for book relatively easy. Page numbers would be nice in editing mode.

I find writing down the experience as it happens is less stressful then having to remember back on each day. I write as I go and add pictures (save as draft).  At end of day “publish” that is when your friends can view.
author: Pemberly5

title: Makes trip planning easy
content: We really like this app. Friends who don’t want to be on Facebook or public can be in our app group. It’s easy to use.  Family & Friends love to follow our adventures.
author: Birdy Barbara

title: Want to have a search button and overall travel map
content:
It is the best APP I can find to log travels. I would like to put all my previous trips into it but I have some concerns.

I haven’t logged many trips yet but if I have 100 trips, it will be very time consuming to find one particular trip without the search function in the APP

In the PC version, I have a view of my overall travel map and can zoom in for details but in the APP I can not do the same.
author: 照照仙子

title: Forever memories
content: First of all thank you for building this app. My girl and I went on a 6 month long rv trip around the USA. And we used this app from the beginning. We have recorded so many memories and plan on getting one of your books. This app is awesome. Best times of my life all put together nicely thanks to you guys.
author: DRKbadger

title: Best RV or Traveling Buddy!!
content:
Highly recommend this to anyone on the road in an RV or just traveling. Before my big van life trip across the USA I tried several different apps and this one is by far is the best I’ve come across. I wanted something my friends and family could follow even if I didn’t have cell service to be in touch with them all the time. My only silly small issue with the app is not truly knowing how many people are following. They have the secret link you can send out but those people aren’t required to sign up so we had no idea how many people were actually following us. 

I actually even reference it a lot (now) even though my trip is over. It’s the small day to day things you forget you did so I’m thankful we had this on our trip. Also love that you can print a book once you’re done.
author: nothanks1414

title: Great way to keep trip memories
content: I love using this app.  I can go back later and remember all the details of the trip.
author: RMSJTS

title: Five enthusiastic stars!
content: I have never written an app review, but Polarsteps is remarkable! I wanted to get away from sharing my travel photos & updates broadly on social media, but my friends & family really like seeing what’s going on. This app was easy and fun to use, easy to collect my photos, locations and comments - and I am blown away with the ease of creating a travel book and the tremendous quality of the book. Also, I had lots of questions along the way, and the customer support at Polarsteps was impeccable.
author: publicjoy

title: Love it and…
content: Super fun app though it doesn’t let you add another person to your journey? My partner and I went on a long road trip and had a lot of fun with polar steps, posting photos and writing captions so that we can remember it for time to come. I think some improvements should be made like being able to add another polar steps user so you can “co-create a trip” that you are both on together. We always had to post from her phone. Also being able to post at a later date because we were always too busy to post everyday. But the app glitches and you have to publish it using today’s date/time and current location and then you can go back and change it. Too much effort though you should just be able to choose a date and time and location before you post. Overall great app!
author: shiloh415

title: Travels Made Complete!
content: Hundreds of pictures on a vacation narrowed down to your favorite, being able to journal what you are feeling and doing, and then click a few choices and you can have a photo album… I have had this app since 2016 and wouldn’t choose any other way to reminisce about my travels.. this app is fabulous!
author: Jane's joyous journeys

title: Good start

author: evrardbordier

title: This is a Fun and Helpful App!
content: I am really enjoying this app! It is fun and easy to use and is great for journaling your trip. Will likely have a book made when my trip is complete.
author: RFPD64

title: Once great, now frustrating and buggy
content: I used to love this app, but it’s recently become virtually unusable on my iPhone. My changes often are not saved and don’t sync, very short videos simply won’t upload when in the past, longer videos would upload without any issues, and it seems I can only use it on a laptop. I’ve wasted a great deal of time crafting comments for entries only to have it randomly refresh and erase everything I had just written or uploaded. I really hope they address these issues but until they do, I can’t recommend using it.

title: Buggy
content: Buggy app - unfortunate because surface level it’s really nice but I’ve encountered random bugs through the experience that don’t ever get fixed (and I’ve reported multiple times for months).
author: vvdesigns

title: Always room for improvement
content: Really amazing concept. Am disappointed that your planned steps can’t be more specific than the city. Like we are planning regular weekend trips where we visit one small city for a few days and I want to add that we are going to the museum, then the library etc. but it wont get that specific. My suggestion would be to at least allow notes to be made on each step so that you could notate which place you plan to visit.
author: ekw95

title: Can’t edit dates
content:
Update: I was contacted by the developer with a workaround accessing through the desktop. This seemed to work. Looking forward to more permanent fix. 

 I really want to love this app and I uploaded all my steps and photos for a visit to Croatia but the dates are messed up and can’t be edited. The end date is stuck and when I try to change it or select ‘no end date’ the app shuts down. Also, I can’t select ‘tracker’ feature. I am happy to update my review when this bug gets fixed. Right now I feel like I’ve wasted hours uploading and setting all the steps. I sent an email to support, let’s see what happens. Frustrated.
author: CovertCastaway

title: Great for International
content:
I really like this app. It’s a lot of fun to see statistics about how many countries you’ve been to, miles you’ve traveled, percentage of the world seen, etc. I just have three things that would make this app more enjoyable to me: 

 1) The ability to join trips together into one travel book would be great. 

 2) An additional breakdown for flags within countries like the flags of different states in the US. I use Polar Steps as a road trip tracker and just think it would be cool to stack up state flags as well as country flags. 

3) The ability to zoom in on the world map behind my avatar to see all my trips at a glance.

Other than these three minor things, this app is amazing!
author: Rukian (roo-key-en)
